purpose: Bounded official baseline learning stage after failed movement tracking and verified same-host scaling
configuration_policy: Change only scene/terrain count and bounded budget/output name; retain all rewards, physics, optimizer, observations, dependencies and video settings
restore: Official model_4999, Adam, adaptive rate, normalizers, curriculum; reset fresh environment and RNG history
evaluation: After successful training, final checkpoint audit, 1000-frame ONNX parity and five fixed development commands; no held-out use
postprocessing_failure_policy: Keep completed training and all logs; stop the chain, inspect saved data, never retrain to repair analysis
